items.title: Ingrid Sertso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I’m a person whose musical tastes run to Cannonball Adderley in the sixties... [INTERVIEWEE] He was the heavy one, right? There were two brothers.

ctx.x: And you made some things clearer for me. I’m a person whose musical tastes run to Cannonball Adderley in the sixties. Soul jazz you know. So some of the ways you spoke about your music I found very —
He was the heavy one, right? There were two brothers.
